answer: The copper check exists because sybils win whenever fakes are free. Standing rots without use: identities must re-validate with new graded work every few epochs or lose their earning rate. Under the spiral, a clone army is a maintenance burden — every fake needs feeding with fresh work, and the farm's upkeep bill grows with the size of its herd. That is the point of the delta: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
